name: Simple interest
solve: function solve(q){const t=q.toLowerCase().replace(/,(?=\d{3})/g,'');const P=t.match(/\$\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/)||t.match(/(?:principal|on|of)\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);const r=t.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(%|percent)/);const y=t.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*years?/),mo=t.match(/(\d+)\s*months?/);if(!P||!r||!(y||mo))return{answer:null,reason:'Need principal, rate and time.'};const p=+P[1],R=+r[1]/100,T=y?+y[1]:+mo[1]/12;const I=p*R*T,f=v=>v.toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});return{answer:`interest ${f(I)}, total ${f(p+I)}`,steps:[`I = P·r·t = ${p} × ${R} × ${+T.toFixed(4)}`,`= ${f(I)}`]}}

tests.q: simple interest on $5000 at 6% for 3 years
what is the simple interest of 1200 at 4.5 percent for 18 months
